title: Plastic Taste?
text: Plastic Taste?. Is anyone else experiencing a "plastic-like" taste with their coffee?  I've washed and used it multiple times, but still getting a very mild plastic-like taste.  Am I the only one?

description: The West Loop travel mug is made for the modern movers, shakers, commuters, travelers – and for the urban explorer in all of us.
